title: Numerical investigation of turbulent coaxial jets through gradual enlargements and contractions
abstract: Turbulent flow field calculations for confined coaxial streams are presented. The cases of gradual duct enlargement and contraction are analyzed. Turbulence is handled with the standard k-ε model. A marching-forward numerical integration technique is used to sweep the computational domain. Within contractions, turbulence is damped, whereas in expansions the valued of k is increased. Also, general turbulence kinetic energy levels are greater when the internal jet is faster than the annular stream.
